sources.entry: Traccar | GPS tracking system for 2000+ device models

summary.one_liner: Traccar is a free, open source GPS tracking platform whose Java back-end server supports 200+ GPS protocols and 2000+ tracker models.
summary.what_it_does: The repository contains the Java-based back-end server for the Traccar GPS tracking platform. According to the README, it supports more than 200 GPS protocols and 2000+ GPS tracking device models out of the box. It works with any major SQL database and provides a REST API. The README lists features including real-time GPS tracking, driver behaviour monitoring, detailed and summary reports, geofencing, alarms and notifications, account and device management, and email and SMS support. Related Traccar projects named in the README are a browser-based web app, a Manager mobile app, and a Client app for tracking mobile devices.
use_cases: monitor GPS devices in real time
generate GPS trip and summary reports
run a white-label GPS tracking service
how_to_run: curl -o compose.yaml <URL not given in README>
stack: SQL database (any major SQL database, MySQL in Docker Compose example)
notable: Supports 200+ GPS protocols and 2000+ tracker models out of the box
Works with any major SQL database
Free to self-host; official managed hosting also available
Companion web dashboard, Manager app, and Client app
caveats: Build from source is described only by reference to the official website, not in the README
